decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper extends the firm's established construction range, and industry turnover is growing, so performance likely meets aspirations and there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The articulated dumper builds on existing engineering and service capabilities, so its results are unlikely to fall far enough below aspiration to justify dropping it after only one year.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core offer and riskier, but it uses the firm's underground expertise and the firm's slack (growth, hiring, own R&D) lets it carry an uncertain niche product for longer.
The multi-model compact telescopic loader line is a substantial commitment adjacent to the firm's lifting equipment, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon after launch.
